description: A burly warrior with a green, warty, pig-like face, small red eyes, pointed ears and a snarling mouth, wearing a black spiked helmet with a central point. It is clad in heavy brown leather armor made of square studded plates, with thick padded arms. On its left arm it carries a tall oblong wooden shield with vertical planks and a round purple boss; in its right hand is a curved white blade. It is shown half-length, facing the viewer at eye level, against a plain pale cyan background. The mood is aggressive and rough. Frame 1: the sword is swung forward and up across the body, angled toward the shield. Frame 2: the sword is drawn back low, held flat at waist level. The forward swing is held about twice as long as the drawn-back pose, so the loop reads as a steady, threatening chopping motion.
title: Pig-faced warrior with sword and shield
